timing.label: Lap values come from

timing.nowLogger: Now: the logger. Each widget can override this in its settings (Lap timing).

startFinish.title: Start / finish
startFinish.set: Set. Drag its ends on the map to adjust.
startFinish.notSet: Not set: laps come from the logger.
startFinish.fromLoggerHint: Place it where the logger's lap number changes
startFinish.noLapChange: The logger laps do not change anywhere on the GPS path

sectors.title: Sector lines
sectors.hint: In driving order: n lines make n + 1 sectors.

settings.title: Settings
settings.name: Track name
settings.minLapHint: Crossings closer than this are GPS jitter, not a new lap

map.drawHint: Click two points across the track to place the line. Esc cancels.
map.dragHint: Drag the line ends to adjust them. Scroll to zoom, drag to move the map.
map.noGpsPath: The session has no GPS positions: lap lines need a GPS path.

laps.title: Laps
laps.hint: Click a lap to jump to its start

range.rejected: Must be inside the timeline, start before end

dataRange.title: Data range
dataRange.hint: The part of the session the widgets’ data comes from. Outside it there is no data; inside it the session starts over: distance from 0, laps numbered from 1, best lap of the kept laps. Each widget can use its own range.
dataRange.noLaps: This session has no laps yet: lap bounds need lap timing (logger laps or a start/finish line).

notEnoughLaps.one: There are not enough completed laps to leave out {count}: the end is not trimmed.
notEnoughLaps.other: There are not enough completed laps to leave out {count}: the end is not trimmed.

problems.empty: The range is empty: its end is before its start.
